title: The ci-hygiene skill says to run check_silent_undo.py with no --upstream, so it compares against the PR base
why: Coordinator 17:45 CST Nov 8; Merge after: #1869 (after it, a run with no --upstream resolves the PR base). Incident: lane notes-fix-large-1's hand-written #2052 fix-check brief passed origin/main to check_silent_undo, so the fix check passed a head that lane lint failed (a #2052 commit reverses a hunk of #1458's d561e8e1f; one 626 s lane-lint run lost). No tool passes origin/main; the brief copied the habit. Fix: the skills/ci-hygiene line that says to run check_silent_undo.py says "with no --upstream". Docs only.
